name: Book of Hearts
source: Book of the Hearts is an emotional story about Jarold, a young dinosaur who's parents maintain the nuclear reactor built underneath their home. Jarold's best friend BeeJee the Beet ran into him earlier that day but their conversation was cut short when an explosion unbuttoned the town. What happened to Jarold's parents? And why is this mysterious heart following him around?
